authorization: User continued V26; existing routine P2A implementation and CPU validation authorization.
scope: Unused sensor-only mapper-v2 candidate, artificial finite measurements and timing only. No World constructor, Node, task asset load, episode, ENV.step, policy, reward replay, native or GPU.

rules_fixed_before_comparison.inputs: Estimated sensor pose, angles, measured ranges, range limits and source scan ID only.
rules_fixed_before_comparison.grid: Original 0.05m artificial comparison lattice; output exactly -1/0/100.
rules_fixed_before_comparison.endpoint_tie: Within four lattice ULPs of an integer, snap numerically; hit with negative ray component uses nextafter toward minus infinity. Other hit endpoints use floor. No metric inflation or thickness prior.
rules_fixed_before_comparison.free_ray_walk: Retain v1 integer start/end rint interpolation; endpoint hit wins free votes in the same scan.
rules_fixed_before_comparison.duplicate: Same latest source ID and exact canonical payload is idempotent; changed payload or older ID rejects atomically.
rules_fixed_before_comparison.new_scan_same_endpoints: Consumes a fresh bounded evidence vote.
rules_fixed_before_comparison.storage: One int8 evidence grid and latest exact payload; no growing history. memory_bytes excludes Python overhead and temporary workspace.
rules_fixed_before_comparison.resource_guard: Reject nonfinite/unsupported lattice or more than 8000000 vectorized ray samples before mutation.

fixed_comparison_families: prescribed +/-0.002m and +/-0.01m, isolated and persistent bias
maximum no-hit and 9.999m to maximum transition
same-scan hit/free conflict and ray permutation
saturated free prior followed by a new obstacle
known nonzero sensor extrinsic and rotated heading
timing: Fixed 48x48 arrays, at most 360 rays x 12 scan calls per implementation per mode/round, three alternating rounds; integrate calls only, no ENV throughput claim.
stopping: Do not tune fixed parameters to artificial outputs. Retain failed CPU attempts; only rerun after a concrete correction, using a fresh output directory. No task or training eligibility can result.
unchanged: Default v1/worker/evaluator/candidates/masks/quality/95percent/300s/received-only/TTL/FIFO/native gates and all historical failures.
